The workspace is a zip file, which needs no account and no sign-in, and it unzips into a folder called `ar4ds-eu-workspace-main`; on Windows, choose "Extract All" rather than working inside the compressed preview. The folder holds the report in which you work, `index.qmd`, the check script and the helpers in `R/`, and in `data/` the data, each file with its codebook. Open the folder in your IDE, in RStudio through the file `ar4ds-eu-workspace.Rproj` inside it, and run `R/check_setup.R` until it reports no failure, as [the setup page](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/setup.html#check-that-it-works) describes.
